column1: # Datapoint vectors. Every row covers a place in dptconvert.cpp that was changed. Expectations come from 03_07_02, not
# from the converter; rows marked "policy" pin a design decision the spec leaves open. expected: OK | REJECT | OK=<output>.

column6: why
NT (flags octet, 02h) marks the time fields not valid (3.20 p.51); policy: the combined value is refused
hour 24 with 0 minutes and 0 seconds is allowed, 3.20 p.51
hour 24 with minutes != 0 has to be ignored, 3.20 p.51
hour 24 with seconds != 0 has to be ignored, 3.20 p.51
regular date and time
hour 99 was folded to 3 by the field mask
upper bounds; Sunday (7) in the top 3 bits of octet 3, 3.11 p.41
minute 60 is out of range (3.11 p.41); it went out unchanged as 3Ch
weekday 3 shares octet 3 with the hour (3.11 p.41); it used to be dropped
the largest finite F32; policy: finite values only, 3.15 p.44 sets no bound
above FLT_MAX used to go out as +Inf; policy: finite values only
spec minimum (M=-2048, E=15), used to be rejected (Fix 67)
below the minimum
9.001 is a temperature: absolute zero is the lower bound
below absolute zero
the wide range does NOT apply to 9.001
7FFFh denotes invalid data for every 9.xxx, 3.10 p.39
upper bound below the invalid marker
would go out as 7FFFh, invalid for 8.010 (3.9 p.37 note b) although the range column lists 327,67 %
7FFFh denotes invalid data for DPT_Percent_V16, 3.9 p.37 note b
0.29 % at 0.01 % resolution is 29; truncation of 28.999... gave 28
angle 0..360 over 0..255 (3.5 p.32); the uint8_t cast folded everything above 255
B32 is a bit field, decoded unsigned; the signed read gave a negative value
policy: a weekday out of range becomes 0 = no day (3.11 p.41) instead of refusing the time
policy: same for a weekday above 7
0 = no day is a valid value, 3.11 p.41
NWD set: the value carries no working-day information; WD=0 alone reads as bank day (3.20 p.50)
hour 24 with 0 minutes and 0 seconds is allowed, 3.20 p.51
hour 24 with minutes != 0 must be refused, not encoded
hour 24 with seconds != 0 must be refused
a negative hour must not be bent to 31 by the mask
a negative minute must not be bent by the mask
a negative second must not be bent by the mask
tm_year is the absolute year here; 126 is below the 1900 offset (3.20 p.50)
month 13 does not exist; tm_mon is 1..12 in the KNX convention
one hour is 0001h whatever the machine's time zone; a mktime() round trip shifted it
manufacturer code (2 octets) then the 32-bit number, 3.30 p.71; dataLength gave 1 octet and the number was masked to 16 bits
R G B W, reserved octet, mR mG mB mW set (6.18 p.194); 6 octets, not 4
DPT_Heat/Cool exists (p.114) and was rejected
DPT_Value_ApparentPower exists (3.15 p.46) and was rejected
setvalue 100 % is FFh in the high octet, 2 octets in all (3.51.1 p.100); dataLength had it wrong
channel activation is b0 of the low octet (3.51.1 p.100)
